args:
Add fitting model try-on looks feature to outfit recommendation card.

  CURRENT STATE:
  - Outfit recommendation card shows flat-lay image (items laid out on white background)
  - User has a fitting model generated during onboarding (stored in user profile)
  - fitting-model-service.ts exists but only generates base model in standard outfit

  REQUIRED FEATURE:
  After showing flat-lay image, add a 'ลองใส่' (Try On) button that generates and shows the outfit WORN on the user's fitting model.

  IMPLEMENTATION:
  1. Add new function generateTryOnLooks() in fitting-model-service.ts that:
     - Takes user's fitting model image (from profile) as reference
     - Takes recommended outfit items (dress, shoes, accessories)
     - Generates image of the model WEARING those items
     - Uses same face-matching prompt pattern as existing fitting model generation

  2. Update OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx to:
     - Add 'ลองใส่' button next to 'ดูลุค' button
     - When clicked, show loading skeleton
     - Call generateTryOnLooks() with user's fitting model and outfit items
     - Display generated try-on image in a modal or expanded view

  3. Create prompt template based on data/personas/prompt_gen/fitting_model.md:
     - Reference image = user's fitting model from onboarding
     - Outfit = recommended items (dress name, shoes, accessories)
     - Generate model wearing the actual recommended outfit

  4. Store try-on image URL in outfit object for caching

  RELEVANT FILES:
  - apps/web/lib/services/fitting-model-service.ts
  - apps/web/components/chat/OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx
  - apps/web/lib/hooks/useUserProfile.ts (to get user's fitting model)
  - data/personas/prompt_gen/fitting_model.md (prompt reference)
